name: use-map
title: useMap
description: Represents the type for either a Map or an array of key-value pairs.

tags.template: - The type of values in the map.

types.name: MapOrEntries
types.description: Represents the type for either a Map or an array of key-value pairs.

types.name: UseMapReturn
types.description:
Represents the return type of the `useMap` hook.
We hide some setters from the returned map to disable autocompletion.

types.name: UseMapActions
types.description: Represents the actions available to interact with the map state.

properties.name: set
properties.description: Set a key-value pair in the map.

properties.name: setAll
properties.description: Set all key-value pairs in the map.

properties.name: remove
properties.description: Remove a key-value pair from the map.

properties.name: reset
properties.description: Reset the map to an empty state.

parameters.name: initialState
parameters.description: - The initial state of the map as a Map or an array of key-value pairs (optional).

returnType.name: UseMapReturn<K, V>
returnType.description: A tuple containing the map state and actions to interact with the map.
